byte_counting_rules.common_downstream_predictor: excluded from every condition as common task-head overhead
byte_counting_rules.MEM: model_bytes=0; retained_state_bytes=pickle protocol 5 bytes of sorted exact lookup state plus fallback label
byte_counting_rules.L0-L4: model_bytes=pickle protocol 5 bytes of fitted EncoderWrapper required for representation inference; retained_state_bytes=0
byte_counting_rules.serialized_artifact_bytes: same canonical inference-state serialization; excludes reports/logs/temp artifacts

utility_noninferiority_tolerance.justification: Task default; all current downstream utility metrics are normalized accuracy.

failed_run_handling: retain failed attempt; no seed replacement, tuning, or silent retry

mem_semantics.lookup_key: float64 raw-observation row bytes from training split
mem_semantics.value: majority training label per duplicate key; deterministic tie break
mem_semantics.fallback: global majority training label; deterministic tie break
